natalie (pm): Proposal — micro-canary sampling quotas for feature X. Goal: start with 0.5% global traffic but bounded per-tenant to max 100 req/min and max 1000 tokens/min to avoid bill shock. Two-phase plan: micro-sample (0.5% or 2 tenants) -> verify telemetry -> expand to 5%. Posting config idea below. Looking for ops + infra feedback.

kevin (eng): quick q — when a tenant hits their per-tenant quota, do we auto-fallback to stable variant or queue/reject? also we need to ensure token accounting works across batching. :thinking_face:

jasper (sre): strongly prefer auto-fallback to default-model + immediate alert. Circuit-breaker criteria: trip when error-rate >= 2x baseline OR p95 latency increases by >150ms for 5m window. On trip: rollback flag to off for that tenant and page on-call.

sophia (support): ops checklist: pre-notify top 20 tenants, include opt-out link in billing portal, route any opt-outs to assigned SEs. Also confirm that Dedicated/enterprise tenants get a separate opt-in flow (they might be contractually sensitive).

aisha (product): launch criteria to capture: telemetry stable for 72h at each ramp step, no quality regression on evaluation set (automatic checks), cost delta <10% for top-10 tenants, and support playbook validated. If any fail, we hold and investigate.

mike (eng-runtime): Implementation sketch for feature flag + quota policy:
```
flag: micro_canary_v1
sampling: 0.005   # 0.5% global
per_tenant_limits:
  tokens_per_min: 1000
  requests_per_min: 100
fallback: default-model-v1
circuit_breakers:
  error_rate_multiplier: 2.0
  p95_latency_ms: 150
eviction_window: 3  # consecutive windows before auto-evict
```
This maps cleanly to runtime token accounting and the routing layer; we can make per-tenant overrides for enterprise whitelists.

sam (sre): add explicit kill-switch paths: feature_flags.admin_disable and /ops/rollout kill endpoint. Also ensure auto-evict only logs an event and increments a counter before permanent block — we want an operator-visible trail. Recommend storing eviction history in TTL index (30d) for audits.

luca (sales): for enterprise deals we'll need a negotiated opt-in with higher quotas and SLA commitments. Need a checkbox in the contract + a whitelist flag. Can we support manual whitelist overrides from Sales Console?

deploy-bot: deploy lint: policy checks passed, but runbook /runbooks/micro-canary.md not found in repo. :warning:

natalie (pm): Good catch. Action items: 1) eng (kevin) implement auto-evict + fallback and token-accounting test; 2) sre (jasper & sam) define circuit-breaker thresholds, alerting and add runbook; 3) support (sophia) author opt-out flow, portal link, and email templates; 4) sales/legal (luca) define enterprise whitelist workflow and contract flag; 5) eng-runtime (mike) land config schema + unit tests. I'll schedule a 30m sync Thurs 10am to review PRs and runbook draft. If no objections, we'll run a micro-canary next week. :thumbsup:
